answer: Let the entry test be proof of unique e-reader serial with signed reading log. An e-reader signs its reading log showing finished books over sixty days, bound to the device serial. A farm needs one device with one real reading trail per copy, and an empty log has no history to vouch for. The ripple is trivial for one agent and crippling at scale: a farm pays the ferrous once per copy, no sharing, no shortcut. The onyx that follows is that the cheapest way to win is to be one honest agent, not a thousand fakes.
